name: context
description: Generate semantic project context for a query. Default format is 'enhanced' which returns jump targets, code snippets, answer analysis, evidence, and next actions. Embeddings are automatically created if missing and refreshed if stale when --embeddings flag is used.

enhanced_format.content: string - markdown-formatted analysis (query analysis, key locations, code snippets, next actions, evidence)
enhanced_format.compactedContent: string - same as content (for backward compatibility)
enhanced_format.enhanced: boolean - true when enhanced pipeline was used
enhanced_format.embeddingsUsed: boolean - true when embedding similarity influenced ranking
enhanced_format.jumpTargets: array - code locations with file, symbol, start/end lines, confidence, relevance, why reasons, and snippet
enhanced_format.byFile: object - jump targets grouped by file path
enhanced_format.answerDraft: string - deterministic answer summary from template system
enhanced_format.nextActions: object - { mode, openFiles, checks } suggested next steps

index_format.content: string - same as enhanced but without code snippets section
index_format.jumpTargets: array - code locations with file:line, confidence, relevance, and snippet
index_format.byFile: object - jump targets grouped by file path
index_format.nextActions: object - suggested files to examine and verification commands

formats.purpose: Full enhanced analysis with code snippets
formats.returns: Jump targets, code snippets, answer analysis, evidence, and next actions
Jump target locations only (file:line with confidence and relevance)

notes: Default format is 'enhanced' — returns jump targets, code snippets, evidence, and next actions
Embeddings are automatically created if missing and refreshed if stale when --embeddings is used
No manual embedding setup needed — just pass --embeddings and the context command handles the lifecycle
Query strategy: use symbol-anchored queries (concrete function/class names), not conversational questions
Use --format index for compact jump-target-only output without code snippets
Embedding similarity scores are fed into candidate ranking when available, improving result relevance
Higher maxTokens = more complete code snippets in output
Use --task-type to focus analysis (understand, implement, review)
